summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Place sims assemble local layouts, populations and hazards around shared player, NPC, loot and combat systems; the farm route now reaches Level 184, while Level 11 combines its modelled city with scripted quests and objectives.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored fixtures, containers, shifting walls and hunters, with solo rooms by default.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus Level 2.1 simulated rooms, zones, agents and set pieces.
places/level3, places/gamma (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators and lifts; Gamma includes Marlo the smith.
places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; office structure/residents and hotel encounters, including Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level6, places/level61 (3D) - Lights Out and Snackrooms; Level 6.1 food-court shops, service, vending and Camp Amber connect onward to Level 11.
places/level7 (3D) - ocean and room spaces; places/debug is a separate dark test atmosphere; places/spamton is a wet-concrete basement showroom and boss arena.

places/level10 (3D, Bumper Crop) - heightmapped farm and canola threshold to places/level184 (3D, Field of Forgotten Forts), whose sunny rolling fields, stone walls, farms and sheds return through a wall gap.
places/level11 (3D, The Infinite City) - generated city districts, subway, Sedco Spotlight, street life, Thrift Mode, skydeck elevator, modelled enterable apartment and quest locations.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares player actions, camera, player template and HUD, routing, and an eight-player cap; Backspace opens the main menu.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion/player precede swim, interactions and gameplay handlers, then spamton-fight, critter, main-menu and view3.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; scripts/view3.js toggles player.state.tp.
places/<place>/config.yaml + sim.js + cells - place setup and placements; sims build local layouts and tick local behavior, generally sleeping when empty.
sim.js - world cadence and onOutOfBounds referee; players return true for normal respawn, creatures with state.home return home, others are destroyed for manager respawn.

places/level10/config.yaml + places/level10/sim.js + places/level184/config.yaml + places/level184/sim.js - farm-to-countryside route; terrain10/terrain184 generate height and materials, sims lay local set pieces.
places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js - Level 11 city, street and underground assembler; includes shop and apartment placements.
places/spamton/sim.js + scripts/spamton-boss.js - dedicated arena entry; sim lays basement and lights and manages boss presence; boss runs encounter and scripts/ui.js mounts arena HUD.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait and heading for player and M.E.G. NPC chains; caches measured paces by model/scale; scripts/lib/body3.js supplies weapon animation and rowing.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js through level7.js + data - per-level grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by simulations, geometry, labels and creature navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.

scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/clothes/faces data - seeded coats, face traits and expressions plus rendered heads/bodies/garments; mask children are attached from garment rows.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing and container helpers; art/props/build.py supplies modeled lockers/fridges.
scripts/lib/combat.js + scripts/lib/data/combat.yml + scripts/lib/ballistics.js - shared hit/armor and firearm accuracy/projectile rules used by player and NPC combat.

scripts/lib/condition.js + condition.yml, difficulty.yml and scripts/lib/stats.js - weapon/armor condition, balance multipliers and derived handling/carry values used by player, clothes, loot UI and NPC behavior.

scripts/lib/nav.js + builtin/nav - shared path search budget (3 per tick), 4-second route cache and 0.32 m body radius for meg-agent, l5-staff and l61-staff; scripts/lib/footsteps.js + footsteps.yml detects floor texture and drives player steps.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, L11_FAR, l11Lean, tick; places/spamton/sim.js - cadence, tick.

places/level10/sim.js and places/level184/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/terrain10.js and scripts/terrain184.js - heightAt, materialAt; scripts/barn10.js - geometry, collider; scripts/tree10.js - geometry, collider; scripts/wheat10.js - geometry.
scripts/ambient-anim.js - onSpawn, update; scripts/lib/ambient.js - fan, fanHousing, cable and DRIP, DUST, MIST, SPORES, BUBBLES, RIPPLE builders/effects.
scripts/lib/level21.js - grid, room, zone, exit and height queries/constants; scripts/lib/maze21path.js - canPass21, stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/l21-use.js - updateSchedule, ears, update; scripts/level21-geo.js - geometry; scripts/lib/chatter.js - tickChatter, CHATTER.

scripts/l61-use.js - MENUS, ears, landed, takeItem, vendExpire, ready, expire; scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - layExtra, faceling, person, PEOPLE, FACELING_IDS; scripts/lib/snacktray.js - tray constants and helpers.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/lib/level11-shop.js - SHOP, layShop; scripts/level11-elevator.js - updateSchedule, callElevator, ears, update; scripts/l11-gate.js - onSpawn, ears.

scripts/lib/level11-quests.js - QUESTS, setSedcoStep, setCraneStep, setMaintStep, finishQuest, handleDialogueQuest; scripts/level11-use.js - ears; scripts/level-door.js - onTriggerEnter; scripts/lib/nav.js - NAV, navBudget, navPath.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, clothing, karma/rep and Level 11 l11Access; also transient movement/combat state and per-machine data.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; initialize/migrate/spend points, derive carry/combat values and tick companion perks.
scripts/craft.js - craft actions, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; scripts/swim.js owns swimming/underwater/breath and swim session controls, timer and audio.

scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - player focus, loot and sit state; interact.js also assigns nearby containers to NPC owners, persists warn/anger consequences, handles vehicle entry/exit, and tracks the highlighted target.

scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI state and NPC rapport, gifts, trade and rep effects; scripts/lib/level11-quests.js owns quest progress keys sedcoQ/craneQ/maintQ and player.state.quest tracker/reward writes; scripts/lib/rep.js owns karma and group reputation.

scripts/meg-agent.js - NPC routines, attributes/nerve, loadout, combat, fear, cover, idle social coordination and transient movement/path recovery; interact.js writes NPC warned/angry memories; chatter.js writes NPC line/talkAt/talkTo and turn state.

scripts/lib/combat.js owns pure shared combat calculations; combat.yml is their tuning source; player.js applies hits while clothes.js/stats.js apply armor DR; scripts/lib/ballistics.js computes weapon spread and projectile paths.

scripts/os.js owns player.state.os terminal session and per-session panel done flags; it writes player.state.l11Access from panel grants (including sedcofront); scripts/level11-elevator.js owns cab travel session/display and schedule.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js behavior order: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3; configured routing invokes scripts/routing.js.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.

world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js; menu actions and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; creator C uses scripts/wardrobe-ui.js to emit dress actions → scripts/critter.js writes player look/outfits.

Spawn room selection → scripts/routing.js pickRoom: accepted ctx.requestedRoomId preserves invited/portal/party rooms; otherwise derives solo-<normalized userId or username> (guest fallback). Engine out-of-bounds → sim.js handles normal player respawn, creature home or manager respawn.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps paired IDs, writes arrival state.clipKind and calls companion.bring → nearby non-waiting followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind into state.xfer.kind. Level 10 l10-canola-in ↔ Level 184 l184-from-l10 and l184-back ↔ Level 10 l10-from-l184.

places/level10/sim.js tick lays Bumper Crop using height terrain and crop scatter; its canola trigger routes to Level 184, whose places/level184/sim.js tick lays fields' farms, walls, fences and props against terrain184 height/material.

Level 11 sim.js → scripts/lib/level11-city.js layCity/layStreet builds from level11-models.yml and art/level11 models; sim calls layShop, layVaults, tickCity and tickChatter, with versioned incremental rebuild rows/cursor in ctx.session.l11q and place.state.lq.

Level 11 BackOS terminal placements → scripts/computer.js / scripts/os.js session and scripts/os-ui.js screen; terminal grants write player.state.l11Access; SEDCO-SEC-01 also advances sedcoQ through scripts/lib/level11-quests.js.

Level 11 quest flow: scripts/talk.js openDialogue → handleDialogueQuest starts/turns in quests with Courier, Vance, Kael and Janitor; scripts/os.js and scripts/level11-use.js advance Sedco, canal-crane and maintenance objectives; quest helper writes tracker/rewards → scripts/ui.js renders player.state.quest.

Level 11 elevator cab/interior and landing call buttons → scripts/level11-elevator.js callElevator/update moves physical cab between y=0.3 and y=35.7; Porsche interaction parents rider and emits press to its controller.

Level 11 sim tick calls scripts/lib/chatter.js → nearby NPC state.line/talkAt/talkTo and turn gestures; scripts/ui.js renders floating lines/subtitles, and l61-staff.js reacts to chatter listener state; dialogue data includes Dee and other city NPCs.

scripts/player.js update → scripts/lib/footsteps.js stepTick raycasts the surface and reads footsteps.yml for clips/stride/weight; meg-agent, l5-staff and l61-staff → scripts/lib/nav.js navPath → builtin/nav, with shared budget/cache and body radius.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light state and red-zone variants; Level 5 carries portal/quest props and scripts/l5-rats.js runs Boiler Room nest/pack cycles.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office plan, cubicle/phone/printer variants, resident schedules and home claims; Level 7 has its own ocean and room set pieces.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies combat and idle social behavior; clothes.yml/mat-cloth.js/critter-model.js vary garment patterns and masks.
scripts/lib/craft.js + craft data - recipe category, costs, skill, bench, batch size and item family vary per recipe.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - room blocks share generated hall/room structure; room type, zone height, lighting, decor and loot vary by authored grid data and deterministic hashes.

places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - food-court venues share service systems with varying menus and Faceling roles; rebuilds queue solids first and remove stale roots incrementally.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/data/level11-models.yml + art/level11 build kits - uploaded models furnish city districts and street props; seeded kinds/colours/placements vary, while level11-quests.js drives three objective chains over shared interactions.

places/level10/sim.js + places/level184/sim.js and terrain10.js/terrain184.js - heightmapped farm fields share wheat, crop and farm-prop generators; terrain materials, track/marks, scatter and thresholds vary by level.
migrationNotes: Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell (120 m square); keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal, sim geometry/hound routing aligned, and roofAt in place state so ceiling checks survive ticks.

Keep paired arrival IDs aligned: Level 2 ↔ Level 2.1, Level 6 ↔ Level 6.1, Level 6.1 ↔ Level 11, Level 11 ↔ Level 10, and Level 10 l10-canola-in ↔ Level 184 l184-from-l10 / l184-back ↔ l10-from-l184; level-door.js owns pair and transition kind mappings.

Level 10 and Level 184 configs use terrain10.js and terrain184.js heightmap/materialAt; keep terrain-relative y placements and arrival/track regions aligned with sim scenery. l10-lake-deep remains a floor trigger mapped to level7#l7-from-l6.

Weapon condition is player.state.cnd_<weapon>; garment condition lives in player.state.look.cnd keyed by garment token and shared across same kind/colour copies; keep clothes.yml pattern IDs implemented by mat-cloth.js.

scripts/lib/data/combat.yml tunes scripts/lib/combat.js: armor uses DR reduced by penetration then DRe/(DRe + 0.5×damage + 8), capped at 80%; pellets are mitigated individually. Keep player hits, clothes/stats armor, and ballistics aligned.

Level 6.1 rebuild V=53 prioritizes physics solids before stale-root cleanup; Level 11 rebuild V=44 keeps only cursor i in place.state.lq and generated rows/keep/version in ctx.session.l11q. Quest progress is separately persisted in player.state.sedcoQ/craneQ/maintQ; do not conflate it with the HUD tracker player.state.quest.
